scope: Editable AlongPath/FitOnPath SketchText source, above flag, Along alignment/spacing and explicit same-sketch Line/Arc paths; glyph caches preserved without font reconstruction.

integration.returns: Same texts/unresolved/scope summary shape as shared text readers; each samples[].expected_texts is complete helper output for main-entrypoint equality.
integration.merge: Merge texts by native object_id with rectangle reader. Remove unresolved entries only when that same ID is successfully decoded by either reader; preserve unknown Text failures. New helper rejects rectangle tails and rectangle helper rejects path tails.
integration.shared_hook: Authorized optional definition_decoder(data,records,features,text_record,sketch,layout_marker) in decode_sketch_texts. Default behavior/output remains rectangle. Opt-in permits marker0/1 and last11-byte owner; path controls enforce55-tail. Callback fields merge only into nested definition; common source, reciprocal bindings, exact roles/values and sketch feature binding-list validation remain shared.
integration.callback: decode_path_text_definition plus decode_path_text_controls; no full source/parameter reader duplication.

layout.source: E061 Text attributes EntityGenesis0/textex_tag; common font/height/content/parameter bindings. New55-byte suffix vs rectangle183; explicit owner is last11 bytes. Prefix first byte stores above/below, double@1 stores spacing multiplier. Byte immediately after font UTF16 stores Along0/Fit1, proven with both Line and Arc.
layout.alignment_spacing: Captured path horizontal native1->API left0, native3->center1. Nonnegative percentage=(multiplier-1)*100, captured1->0 and1.2->20. Fit has no active alignment/spacing getters; return null canonical values with raw native fields retained.
layout.controller: 9D30FCDC constraint inputs[curveID,TextID], repeated Text reference, counted16-value finite caches, explicit owning sketch reference, observed8-byte guard, count1 and repeated source curve reference. Three cache blocks in KIT captures; character/glyph association is not inferred.
layout.curve_identity: Direct source object ID resolves a typed primary Line337 or Arc348 cache, same decoded sketch membership and explicit cache owner. Native curve tag comes from decoded cache, never from token parsing or geometric proximity.

findings: Line Above/Below source records differ only atbyte107. Along/Fit Line source records differ only atbyte146; Arc pair independently confirms Fit flag at corresponding post-font position. Controller cache positions also change but are not used as layout flags.

Center alignment and20% spacing map to separate integer and float64 controls; common rectangle controls use corresponding native encodings, while this path reader admits only captured left/center values.

All six captures have zero case/getter failures. Text content/font/plain style/height, reciprocal parameter names/roles/expressions/values and actual path definitions agree with independent API getters.
Thirteen prior rectangle outputs match committed source exactly under both default and expanded controls callbacks.
FitOnPathTextDefintion preserves the installed SDK actual class spelling; no undocumented alternative class is invented.
limitations: Only one explicit same-sketch Line or Arc source; BRep edge, cross-sketch, composite path and other curve families unverified.

Only captured plain style, unset flip source flags, nonnegative spacing, left/center Along alignment, Above/Below Along and Above Fit. Path flips/styles/right alignment/Below Fit combinations unverified.
Horizontal/vertical flip, underline, fixed/reference fields remain null where not independently established; actual API false values retained as observations.
Cached matrix frame, character/glyph association, font metrics/outlines/rendering, constraints regeneration and native writer unresolved.
API tokens are opaque evidence; numeric IDs/tags come only from typed native references/caches.
